# International organisation scope. An autocephalous church seated at Constantinople.
oe_ecc_is_ecumenical_ap = {
    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
    var:seat ?= location:constantinople
}

# International organisation scope. The one Byzantium leads: Constantinople's own (the same test as the author's oe_rus_in_byzantine_patriarchate).
oe_ecc_is_byz_ap = {
    oe_ecc_is_ecumenical_ap = yes
    leader_country ?= { tag = BYZ }
}

# International organisation scope. Serbia's church: seated at Peć or led by Serbia, not Constantinople's, not Tarnovo's (vanilla flavor_ser.31 creates it when Dušan is crowned).
oe_ecc_is_pec_ap = {
    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
    NOT = { var:seat ?= location:constantinople }
    NOT = { var:seat ?= location:tarnovo }
    NOT = { leader_country ?= { tag = BYZ } }
    OR = { var:seat ?= location:peja leader_country ?= { tag = SER } }
}

# International organisation scope. Bulgaria's church: seated at Tarnovo or led by Bulgaria (after a vanilla seat-change event Bulgaria may lead a new one elsewhere), not Constantinople's or Peć's.
oe_ecc_is_tarnovo_ap = {
    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
    NOT = { var:seat ?= location:constantinople }
    NOT = { var:seat ?= location:peja }
    NOT = { leader_country ?= { tag = BYZ } }
    OR = { var:seat ?= location:tarnovo leader_country ?= { tag = BUL } }
}

# Any scope. Byzantium leads the autocephalous church seated at Constantinople. False once the empire converts or loses the see.
oe_ecc_byz_ecumenical = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    c:BYZ = { any_international_organizations_member_of = { oe_ecc_is_byz_ap = yes } }
}

# Country scope. A member of Byzantium's ecumenical church.
oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = {
    any_international_organizations_member_of = { oe_ecc_is_byz_ap = yes }
}

# Country scope. A member of Tarnovo's church.
oe_ecc_in_tarnovo_ap = {
    any_international_organizations_member_of = { oe_ecc_is_tarnovo_ap = yes }
}

# Country scope. Leads some autocephalous church (vanilla's can_join_trigger forbids joining another; written as in vanilla's peace treaty destroy_autocephalous_patriarchate).
oe_ecc_leads_an_ap = {
    any_international_organizations_member_of = {
        international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
        leader_country ?= prev
    }
}

# Any scope. Serbia's own church exists.
oe_ecc_pec_ap_exists = {
    any_international_organization = { oe_ecc_is_pec_ap = yes }
}

# Any scope. Tarnovo's church exists.
oe_ecc_tarnovo_ap_exists = {
    any_international_organization = { oe_ecc_is_tarnovo_ap = yes }
}

# Country scope. Orthodox and outside Constantinople's church.
oe_ecc_stray = {
    religion = religion:orthodox
    oe_ecc_in_byz_ap = no
}

# BYZ scope. The hesychasts have the upper hand. From the church framework on (phase 2, oe_ecc_on): they prevail (oe_ecc_dom = 1) or hold a share of 45 or more. Before it (phase 1): the council of 1341 sided with Palamas, or vanilla's flavor_byz.1100 promoted them, or the patriarch is the Athonite monk of the author's oe_flavor_byz.403 c; never while vanilla's suppression modifier lasts.
oe_ecc_hesychast_strong = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_on }
        OR = { var:oe_ecc_dom ?= 1 AND = { has_variable = oe_ecc_hes var:oe_ecc_hes >= 45 } }
    }
    trigger_else = {
        NOT = { has_country_modifier = suppressed_hesychastic_influences_modifier }
        OR = {
            var:oe_ecc_hesy ?= 1
            has_country_modifier = promoted_hesychastic_influences_modifier
            any_character = { has_character_modifier = oe_byz_religion_leader birth_location ?= location:mount_athos }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle: a Rus' or Lithuanian metropolitan event has happened (.50-.57).
oe_ecc_chr_rus_run = {

        var:oe_ecc_done_50 ?= 1
        var:oe_ecc_done_51 ?= 1
        var:oe_ecc_done_52 ?= 1
        var:oe_ecc_done_53 ?= 1
        var:oe_ecc_done_54 ?= 1

        var:oe_ecc_done_56 ?= 1
        var:oe_ecc_done_57 ?= 1
    }

# BYZ scope. Chronicle: the line is over: Rus' broke away, or 1449 came after it began.
oe_ecc_chr_rus_done = {
    oe_ecc_chr_rus_run = yes
    OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_rus global_var:oe_ecc_see_rus = 4 } current_date >= 1449.1.1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle: the line can no longer go on (never once it is over): the framework ended, or never started by 1353, Rus' broke away or has no country left in Constantinople's church, or 1449 came before it began.
oe_ecc_chr_rus_void = {
    oe_ecc_chr_rus_done = no
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_ecc_off
        AND = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_on } current_date >= 1353.4.1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_rus global_var:oe_ecc_see_rus = 4 }
        oe_ecc_rus_host_ok = no
        current_date >= 1449.1.1
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The random pool may roll this month (design 3.4 step 7.3, decision 206): the framework has been explained (.21), 36 months have passed since the last pool event (oe_ecc_pool_cd), the shared story gap is open (gen_story_gap.py) and some pool event can come.
oe_ecc_pool_ok = {
    oe_ecc_live = yes
    has_variable = oe_ecc_done_21
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_pool_cd }
    oe_story_gap_open = yes
    OR = { oe_ecc_ok_90 = yes oe_ecc_ok_91 = yes oe_ecc_ok_92 = yes oe_ecc_ok_93 = yes oe_ecc_ok_94 = yes }
}

# Any scope. The City is lost (design 4.2): its owner is not Byzantium, not a rebel state (a civil war) and not a subject of Byzantium (the vassal sultan line's usurper). No grace period: the owner changes only by a treaty, an annexation or a script; an occupation does not count.
oe_ecc_city_lost = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    location:constantinople = {
        has_owner = yes
        NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# Any scope. The church recorded in the global oe_ecc_ap (Constantinople's, led by BYZ) no longer exists. Engine assumption (in-game check 3): exists on a variable that points at a destroyed organisation reads false without an error, as vanilla's can_join_trigger writes it.
oe_ecc_ap_gone = {
    has_global_variable = oe_ecc_ap
    NOT = { exists = global_var:oe_ecc_ap }
}

# Any scope. Shared trigger for every line (design 4.2, 5.3): the Ecumenical Patriarchate still counts: the church lines were not closed, Byzantium leads Constantinople's church and the City is not lost. Later lines read this (or the global oe_ecc_fall) and never write oe_ecc_fall.
oe_ecc_stands = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_fall }
    oe_ecc_byz_ecumenical = yes
    oe_ecc_city_lost = no
}

# Character scope. Vanilla's is_patriarch is set but points at no organisation that exists (a dissolved church). Engine assumption (in-game check 3): exists reads such a marker as false without an error.
oe_ecc_pat_dangling = {
    AND = { has_variable = is_patriarch NOT = { exists = var:is_patriarch } }
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle row ecf: the church framework runs.
oe_ecc_chr_fw_run = {
    oe_ecc_live = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle row ecf: the framework ran and ended (the City lost, the church dissolved, or the empire no longer leads it).
oe_ecc_chr_fw_done = {
    has_variable = oe_ecc_on
    has_variable = oe_ecc_off
}

# BYZ scope. Chronicle row ecf: the framework never started and never will (closed by phase 6 before it began).
oe_ecc_chr_fw_void = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_on }
    has_variable = oe_ecc_off
}
